---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new mechanic, entity, level or editor tool
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What would you like?**
Describe the feature (for a Super Mario Bros. 3 element: which one, and how it
behaves in the original game).

**Why?**
The problem it solves or what it adds to the game / the editor.

**Ideas for the implementation** (optional)
Files concerned, alternatives you thought about...

**Would you like to work on it?**
- [ ] Yes, I would like to open a pull request.
